notes.title: Behold the great war horse!
notes.content:
One of our heroes have now his own loyal friend the [b]"War Horse"[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34789578/fab6273d6836f6780f495503953ea7920379a891.png[/img]

[h1]The main mission of the horse
[/h1]The horse is part of the RPG genre from 2 exiting genres that the game includes.
In the RPG genre, you will ride your loyal horse to collect cards by finishing quests and conquer the enemies of the human nation.
